adjudication.rationale: In the new helper `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts), the function returns the result of `schema.safeParse(...)` (a Zod SafeParseReturn object with `{ success, data }`), not the parsed token object itself. In GoogleCalendarService (packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts), the diff changes `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials);` to `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then persists `key` directly via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. That would store the SafeParse wrapper into `credential.key`, corrupting the expected credential shape on refresh.
